name: Furuya Metal Co., Ltd.
summary: Furuya Metal Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells industrial-use precious metal products and temperature sensors in Japan, Asia, Europe, and North America. The company offers various metals processing products, such as iridium crucibles and seed holders, reflectors, and after heaters; platinum (Pt) and Pt alloy glass melting equipment materials for melting optical and LCD glass; Pt crucibles, evaporation dishes, and boats; bead dishes, Pt cells, and tongs with Pt; mesh, sheets, foils, pipes, and wire products; iridium tools for friction stir welding; and thermocouples products.
